description: This file defines a custom unittest loader class 'OETestLoader' for loading and filtering test cases in the OpenEmbedded build system, including methods for discovering tests, filtering by tags and modules, and handling test case setup.

classes.name: OETestLoader
classes.description: A custom unittest loader class for loading, filtering, and discovering test cases within the OpenEmbedded testing framework.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the test loader with test configuration parameters, including module paths, filters, and registry.

methods.name: _patchCaseClass
methods.description: Adds custom attributes to the test case class for tracking context.

methods.name: _registerTestCase
methods.description: Registers a test case instance in the test registry.

methods.name: _handleTestCaseDecorators
methods.description: Processes decorators attached to test cases for setup.

methods.name: _filterTest
methods.description: Determines whether a test case should be filtered out based on module, class, name, and tags.

methods.name: _getTestCase
methods.description: Creates and returns a test case instance, monkey-patching setup/teardown methods.

methods.name: loadTestsFromTestCase
methods.description: Loads all test methods from a given test case class, applying filters.

methods.name: _required_modules_validation
methods.description: Validates that required modules/tests are present in the registry.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers and loads test modules from specified paths, including handling duplicates and custom discovery classes.

methods.name: _filterModule
methods.description: Determines whether a module should be loaded based on its name and configuration.

methods.name: loadTestsFromModule
methods.description: Loads tests from a module, with compatibility for different Python versions.
